description: Pins a note to the top of a contact's card (pinned: true) or unpins it (false), as the note's pin on the contact card does. noteId comes from read (entity client notes). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: pin_client_note
title: Pin or unpin a client note
